hero.title: Armaan Agrawal
hero.subtitle: I build startups and write about what I learn along the way.
hero.description: Most of my time goes into starting companies, thinking about productivity, and exploring how technology shapes business. I share what works and what doesn't.

aboutPreview.heading: What I Do
paragraphs: I'm a founder working on ideas at the intersection of technology and human behavior. My focus is on building products that help people work better and think clearer.

Before this, I spent time studying how teams operate, why some startups succeed while others fail, and what makes productivity systems actually stick. These questions still drive most of what I work on.
I write to understand things better. If you're working on similar problems or just want to exchange ideas, reach out.

workItems.title: Building in Public
workItems.description: I'm currently working on tools that help founders make better decisions faster. The first version launches soon.

workItems.title: Productivity Research
workItems.description: A year-long experiment testing different productivity systems on real teams. Compiling the findings into a series of essays.

cta.heading: Let's Connect
cta.description: I'm always interested in meeting people working on hard problems. Whether you're starting something, investing in founders, or just exploring ideas, say hello.
